bug_semantics: In the public photo image view, an unauthenticated request-controlled order value other than created reaches DBStructure::existsColumn('photo', [$order_field]). existsColumn concatenates that value inside SHOW COLUMNS FROM `photo` LIKE '<value>' and calls DBA::p with no bound arguments; DBA::p consequently uses PDO::query or mysqli::query. A quote-bearing order value can therefore alter the SQL statement before the value is later accepted as an ORDER BY field.
flaw_origin: Commit f8f3689a0d7fa0c2ed886646dde8d284233e923f added the DBStructure::existsColumn guard to the pre-existing request-controlled order path. Its direct parent passed the value only to the structured select order option and did not connect it to existsColumn's raw SHOW COLUMNS construction, so this one-parent, three-line commit is the smallest public object that created the advisory's source-to-sink path.
ai_marker: No AI marker on the BIC: the complete commit message contains only a Friendica issue-comment URL, the commit has matching human author/committer identity Philipp <admin@philipp.info>, GitHub maps both identities to user nupplaphil, and GitHub reports a valid PGP signature.
evidence: The frozen bundle and live GitHub advisory identify GHSA-8xqr-cc5h-9wvp / CVE-2026-72550 as an unauthenticated SQL injection through the photo-view order parameter; CVE.org state is PUBLISHED and lists versions through 2026.08-dev as affected.
At origin/develop mod/photos.php, the view path assigns $_GET['order'] to $order_field and sends any nonempty non-created value to DBStructure::existsColumn('photo', [$order_field]).

At origin/develop src/Database/DBStructure.php, existsColumn forms SHOW COLUMNS FROM the escaped table name but directly concatenates the unescaped column between single quotes, then calls DBA::p($sql).
At origin/develop src/Database/Database.php, p() uses PDO::query when there are no arguments and mysqli::query for SHOW statements/no arguments, establishing the raw query sink.

git log -S for DBStructure::existsColumn('photo' isolates f8f3689a0d7fa0c2ed886646dde8d284233e923f; its patch adds the import and the existsColumn predicate only, and its sole parent is fde223327fb39b0dff84eceb2af29734f7c78aac.
The parent version at fde223327fb39b0dff84eceb2af29734f7c78aac has only elseif (!empty($order_field)) and therefore lacks the vulnerable existsColumn source-to-sink edge.
The BIC is contained by release tag 2023.04 and every later local release tag through 2026.05-1, as well as origin/stable, origin/develop, and origin/2026.08-rc.
The dangerous caller and sink remain present in origin/stable, origin/develop, and origin/2026.08-rc after the advisory publication date; no direct fix is present in the available clone refs.

The BIC's full local commit object and GitHub commit API response contain no AI attribution, assistant trailer, generated-by marker, or bot identity; the API reports a verified PGP signature for the matching human author and committer.
reasoning: The advisory mechanism is real in source: request data reaches an unparameterized database metadata query. The atomic causal change is f8f3689a0d7fa0c2ed886646dde8d284233e923f, not the older existsColumn implementation by itself, because the direct parent has no untrusted call edge to that sink. The commit is not a merge, its parent is available, and no finer member exists to decompose. AI-role judgment is restricted to that BIC; its human identity, valid personal signature, and marker-free complete message support NOT_AI. Since all available maintained refs still contain both source and sink after publication, the case is explicitly unpatched rather than assigned an inferred fix.
remaining_gap: No vendor fix or vendor disposition is linked by GHSA/CVE and no fix commit exists in the available clone refs; consequently fixed-release boundaries cannot be established. The first affected extant release is 2023.04, while the advisory only states affected through 2026.08-dev.

potential_fix.approach: Stop interpolating $column in DBStructure::existsColumn: bind the LIKE value as a query parameter; if SHOW COLUMNS cannot be prepared on a supported driver, validate the requested column against the static photo schema before calling existsColumn.
potential_fix.rationale: This removes request data from raw SQL at the shared sink while preserving the intended dynamic sort-field check; a static schema allowlist is the safe fallback for drivers that cannot prepare SHOW statements.
